How long is Celeste 64: Fragments of the Mountain?
When focusing on the main objectives, Celeste 64: Fragments of the Mountain is about 1 Hours in length. If you're a gamer that strives to see all aspects of the game, you are likely to spend around 2½ Hours to obtain 100% completion.
Celeste 64: Fragments of the Mountain will take you approximately 2 Days to complete if you play for 1.5 hours a day while focusing on some extra content.
